findings.source_claim: The reverse-kernel algorithm initializes x_N, repeats correction and kernel sampling from k=N down to 1, optionally projects and validates the state, returns x_0 at k=1, and halts with a failure status when a required operation fails.
findings.observed_render: The local preview displays a red “diagram failed to render” box containing raw TikZ instead of the flowchart. The screenshot manifest records one diagram failure; no KaTeX errors are recorded.
findings.expected_content: A flowchart with initialization → correction → kernel draw → optional projection/admissibility check → k=1 decision. The k=1 branch returns x_0; the k>1 branch loops to correction at k-1 with the produced state. Initialization, correction, sampling and projection failures route to the failure-status endpoint.
findings.content_to_draw_or_check: Label initialization by x_N~nu_N and b_init; correction by a_k=C_k(x_k,y) and its bottom check; kernel draw x_{k-1}~Q_{theta,k}(.|x_k,y,a_k) and b_k; optional Pi_{k-1} and A_{k-1}; decision k=1; return x_0 or loop with k-1. Keep failure arrows tied to their stages and do not imply any distributional identity.
findings.limitation: Local HTML preview only; this records a diagram rendering defect and does not assess the algorithm’s mathematical validity.

findings.source_claim: The example defines a one-channel one-pixel network whose map is D-tilde_sigma(z)=a tanh(az/sigma^2)+b, composed from a 1x1 convolution, tanh activation, output scale a, and bias b.
findings.observed_render: The local preview prints the TikZ commands as ordinary text between the diagram explanation and Facts & Assumptions. The screenshot manifest reports tikz_count 0 and no diagram failure, but visual inspection confirms literal source exposure because this block uses tilde fences.
findings.expected_content: A compact left-to-right network diagram showing input z, convolution with weight a/sigma^2, tanh activation, output scaling by a plus bias b, and output D-tilde_sigma(z).
findings.content_to_draw_or_check: Render the authored diagram in source lines 67–79 using a renderer-recognized TikZ fence. Preserve the function-composition order and ensure the output node matches the displayed D-tilde equation.
findings.limitation: Local HTML preview only; this records a diagram rendering defect and does not assess the example’s mathematical validity.
